nodes.name: Ni foam cleaning
nodes.procedure: A piece of Ni foam was carefully sonicated in acetone, 1.0 M HCl, deionized water and ethanol for 15 min to clean the surface, respectively.

nodes.name: NiCo-precursor hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 1.00 mmol of Co(NO3)2·6H2O, 6.00 mmol of CO(NH2)2 and 1.00 mmol of NH4F were dissolved in 30 mL of deionized water to form a pink solution. As-obtained pink solution with treated Ni foam was transferred to 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and heated at 120°C for 6 h. Then, the precursor was collected, washed with deionized water and ethanol for several times and dried in vacuum overnight.

nodes.name: NiCoP phosphorization
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared precursor and 4.72 mmol of NaH2PO2·H2O were placed at both ends of a tubular furnace, and NaH2PO2·H2O was at the upstream side. The phosphating process was conducted at 300°C for 2 h with a heating rate of 2°C min⁻¹ under continuous Ar flow.
nodes.source_text: And the NiCo precursor was converted to NiCoP by a phosphating process... under continuous Ar flow.

nodes.name: CeO2 electrodeposition on NiCoP
nodes.procedure: 5.00 mmol of NaCl and 1.00 mmol of Ce(NO3)3·6H2O were dissolved in 80 mL of H2O to form a homogeneous solution which was kept warm at 70°C. The synthesized NiCoP was electrodeposited as the cathode in the prepared solution containing Ce³⁺ at the constant current of 0.25 mA cm⁻² for 300 s.
